editing_treatments.text: Opening beat: a defocused handheld shake that a fast push-in resolves through a rack focus onto 图1, replacing any clean start on the first keyframe.

A fixed dual-circular lens mask over the entire video: black feathered vignette, identical position, size and edge softness, no deformation or drift, with movement confined to the imagery inside the mask.

Binocular scan transition at every cut: whip, motion blur, optical ghosting and exposure flicker, switching at the point of maximum blur and then rapidly stabilizing and re-focusing along the same unfinished movement.

Red text load: slightly defocused low-opacity onset resolving to clear within 0.3–0.5 s, optional small vertical slide-in or letter-spacing breathing, fading out or carried off by motion blur before each switch, never rotating, bouncing or flying in/out widely.

global_style.text: Wes Anderson voyeuristic 35mm film texture throughout: slight grain, soft highlight bloom, restrained color, red text accent, minimal and elevated with a slightly quirky liveliness.

audio_requirements.text: generate_audio is enabled, but the user specifies no music, silence, dialogue or lyric content, so the soundtrack is open design limited to minimal ambience, mechanically synced focus/scan sounds and one restrained audience-only cue.

shots.content_purpose: Reveal the first sighting: the defocused handheld view resolves onto the 图1 bus-shelter composition and its red captions become legible.
shots.start_state: Interior image heavily defocused and shaking inside a completely motionless mask; no caption layer yet.
shots.action: Fast push-in with rack focus onto 图1; captions load soft and faint and sharpen; the view begins its upward-rightward whip as the captions are carried off.
shots.end_state: 图1 composition sharp and stable; captions gone; interior image accelerating into unreadable blur up and to the right.
sound_cues: low street ambience under the defocused opening
a short air swish entering with the outgoing whip

shots.content_purpose: New sighting: the MINIMAX fabric banner flutters in restrained wind while its lettering stays legible.
shots.start_state: The same up-and-right sweep at peak blur, interior image unreadable.
shots.action: Sweep decelerates, stabilizes and refocuses onto 图2; framing holds still while the cloth flutters; captions load and later clear.
shots.end_state: Banner settled in its facade composition, lettering legible, interior image beginning the next sweep down and to the left.
sound_cues: strained wind and cloth rustle riding the visible flutter
the scan swish decelerating into the settle
a small mechanical tick as the focus lands
shots.cut_reason: User-locked keyframe: the second sighting is a different city location, so the scan must cross a boundary at the peak of the whip blur.
shots.continuity_bridge: Shot 1 ends with the interior image whipping up and to the right into unreadable blur; Shot 2 opens on that same sweep at peak blur, continuing in the same direction as it decelerates and refocuses.

shots.content_purpose: New sighting and new subject: the rooftop woman performs a natural walking, turning and arm-swinging movement.
shots.start_state: The down-and-left sweep at peak blur.
shots.action: Sweep slows, stabilizes and refocuses onto 图3; framing holds steady while she walks, turns and swings her arms; captions load and clear.
shots.end_state: Her movement completed within the rooftop composition, captions gone, interior image beginning a rightward sweep that closes toward the face.
sound_cues: thin rooftop air and distant city traffic
the scan swish dying away as the view stabilizes
shots.cut_reason: User-locked keyframe: the third sighting is a separate rooftop location with a different narrative subject.
shots.continuity_bridge: Shot 2 ends with the view whipping down and to the left into blur; Shot 3 opens on that same sweep, continuing down and to the left as it decelerates and refocuses.

shots.content_purpose: Final sighting: the face close-up with one small glasses-adjusting, chin-lifting gesture that lands the cool fashion-campaign attitude.
shots.start_state: The rightward sweep at peak blur, closing in.
shots.action: Sweep decelerates and refocuses onto 图4; she adjusts the red glasses and settles with a slightly lifted chin; captions load and stay legible as the frame settles.
shots.end_state: Final static hold on the 图4 close-up with clear red captions through the end of the video.
sound_cues: the last swish fading under the settle
shots.cut_reason: User-locked keyframe: the final sighting changes scale to a face close-up, which the outgoing rooftop framing cannot present.
shots.continuity_bridge: Shot 3 ends with the view whipping to the right and closing inward; Shot 4 opens on that same rightward sweep, continuing in the same direction as it decelerates onto the close-up.
